scope: Independent read-only review of canonical source identity, existing IDs/agenda/vote preservation, interrupted retries and committee dispatcher; source parser itself was reviewed separately.
checks: Native source body/result and dated catalog voting-body gates precede canonical motion persistence; no model-only formal motion inserts.
Existing primary keys and original agenda IDs retained; uncertain legacy bindings block new inserts, retain history and demote unsupported complete coverage.
Source binary revisions require unique exact native body; previous source keys and bounded history retained.

Cached source-only retry skips cached summary, existing agenda enrichment, key statements, attendance, speaker aliases, transcript replacement, fingerprints and geocoding. New source nodes use explicit neutral source container.
Motion update metadata preserves unrelated fields and legacy before-values; motion and meeting metadata writes use updated_at comparison.

Existing votes append-only; conflicting choices held; pending proof is persisted before individual inserts, and complete coverage is published only after exact whole-ballot readback including retained old IDs.
Unique canonical meeting/source-key index prevents competing new inserts; root reports live valid index definition verified without row mutation.
Known generic CAC catalog labels still require exact native CAC header/date and separately validated committee policy; five CAC proof extras preserved.

validation.focused_tests: Root and owner independently report 121 focused tests passing on frozen final code; not redundantly rerun by reviewer.

residual_limits: Ordinary ingestion uses Supabase REST operations rather than a database transaction. A vote-only external concurrent writer between final vote readback and motion metadata CAS is not locked by that CAS; controlled repair appliers use full transaction locks.
Ambiguous legacy/source identities, duplicate normalized source bodies and unproven source dates intentionally remain held for separate source repair.
